holderQuote: Where to aim? Head, chest—head. Bird drew, and spoke as he loosed.
effectQuote: His arrow curved through the air, heading straight for Badarrow’s head.

holderQuote: The second arrow he loosed was a [Homing Shot] and curved as the Raskghar dodged.
“Those birds are very far away. I have [Long Range Shot] and [Homing Shot], but sometimes they dodge. See?”
effectQuote: So saying, Bird casually drew back and loosed. Mrsha’s keen eyes saw an arrow speeding across the ground at a bird nearly three hundred feet distant. It was an impressive shot, even with a Skill! She lost track of it for a second, but the bird it was targeting dove, and the homing missile flashed over its head.

holderQuote: Bird sang as he loosed arrows. He was bringing down Wyverns. So many and so fast that even Noass and Sir Relz were searching for him. Each arrow hit a Wyvern. Going through joints in the wings, hitting them in the eyes, opened mouths—

She aimed a bow at a fleeing Silver-rank team on a cart.

holderQuote: Bird realized he’d have to aim higher than he had ever thought before.
effectQuote: I might fail. [Long-Range Shot]…[Homing Shot]. [Swallow’s Arrow]. If I fail, though, it’s my fault.
Then, as it curved, a [Homing Shot]…he moved at the last second.
